subtitle.en: Pair a phone or another computer to share the same Web GUI (official UI + mobile adaptation)
subtitle.zh: 通过手机或另一台电脑配对，远程使用同一份 Web 界面（官方界面 + 移动端适配）

status.lanRequired.en: This feature needs a LAN bind or a public address
status.lanRequired.zh: 此功能需要局域网绑定或公网地址才能使用

status.lanRequiredHint.en: The server is bound to 127.0.0.1 and no public address is configured, so a phone cannot reach it. Turn on LAN access in this plugin settings card (under Settings → Web Plugins → Remote access when the full family is installed, or on this plugin row under Settings → Plugins for a standalone install), or restart with dsh web --host 0.0.0.0, or set the tunneled public address.
status.lanRequiredHint.zh: 当前服务仅绑定在 127.0.0.1 且未配置公网地址，手机无法访问。请在本插件的设置卡片中打开“局域网访问”（装在全家桶里时在「设置 → Web 插件 → 远程访问」，单独安装时在设置 → 插件 → 本插件行），或用 dsh web --host 0.0.0.0 重新启动，或填写内网穿透的公网地址。

status.loopbackRequired.en: The pairing panel works on this machine only
status.loopbackRequired.zh: 配对面板仅限本机使用

status.loopbackRequiredHint.en: Open this page at http://127.0.0.1 to mint a QR code; phones use the paired link.
status.loopbackRequiredHint.zh: 请通过 http://127.0.0.1 打开此页面后重试；手机请使用配对链接访问。

status.unreachableHint.en: Refresh the page and try again.

pair.hint.en: Cannot scan? Open one of the pairing links below
pair.hint.zh: 无法扫码？可直接打开下方配对链接

pair.publicHint.en: Public links work when the device is not on the same network
pair.publicHint.zh: 公网链接：设备无需与本机处于同一网络

address.label.en: Network the QR code points to
address.label.zh: 选择二维码指向的网络

address.hint.en: Use the public address when the remote device is on another network; LAN addresses only work on the same network.
address.hint.zh: 远程设备不在同一网络时请使用公网地址；局域网地址仅限同一网络内使用。

pair.dockerHint.en: In Docker or reverse proxy environments, copy this token to pair directly on the target device.
pair.dockerHint.zh: Docker 或反向代理环境下，可直接复制此令牌并在目标设备配对页面输入。

pair.oneTimeHint.en: The link carries a time-limited token: until it expires or the QR is refreshed, the same link can pair several devices, each with its own device session.
pair.oneTimeHint.zh: 链接含限时令牌；在令牌过期或刷新二维码之前，同一链接可为多台设备完成配对（每次配对各自生成独立设备会话）。

pair.failed.detail.en: The link is invalid or has expired. Refresh the QR code on your computer and scan again.
pair.failed.detail.zh: 链接无效或已过期，请回到电脑端刷新二维码后重新扫码。

fence.unpaired.title.en: This device is not paired and cannot reach workspace data
fence.unpaired.title.zh: 此设备未配对，无法访问工作区数据

fence.unpaired.hint.en: To protect workspace, session, and plugin data, a remote computer must first be authorized by the primary computer.
fence.unpaired.hint.zh: 为保护工作区、会话与插件数据，远程电脑必须先通过主电脑授权。

fence.unpaired.stepDesktop.en: On the primary computer, open http://127.0.0.1:3080 and go to Remote access.
fence.unpaired.stepDesktop.zh: 在主电脑打开 http://127.0.0.1:3080，进入“远程访问”。

fence.unpaired.stepLink.en: Copy the computer pairing link under Pair a device.
fence.unpaired.stepLink.zh: 在“设备配对”中复制电脑配对链接。

fence.unpaired.stepOpen.en: Open that link in this browser. After authorization, the workspace will become available.
fence.unpaired.stepOpen.zh: 在当前浏览器打开该链接，完成授权后即可进入。

fence.unpaired.tokenPlaceholder.en: Or paste pairing link / token here
fence.unpaired.tokenPlaceholder.zh: 或在此直接粘贴配对链接 / Token

fence.unpaired.tokenInvalid.en: Pairing link or token is invalid or expired
fence.unpaired.tokenInvalid.zh: 配对链接或 Token 无效已过期

fence.unpaired.tokenFailed.en: Pairing failed, please check network or issue a new link
fence.unpaired.tokenFailed.zh: 配对失败，请检查网络或重新获取链接

fence.unpaired.footnote.en: Do not use pairing links from people you do not trust. An administrator can revoke this device at any time.
fence.unpaired.footnote.zh: 请勿使用他人提供的配对链接；管理员可随时取消此设备的授权。

posture.exposed.en: The /api channel is open to unpaired devices
posture.exposed.zh: /api 通道对未配对设备敞开

posture.exposedHint.en: Requests from {hosts} reach the full desktop API without pairing. Remove --trusted-host for them (pairing already covers remote access), or bind loopback only and use the tunnel.
posture.exposedHint.zh: 以下来源的请求未经配对即可访问完整桌面 API：{hosts}。请移除对应来源的 --trusted-host（配对机制已覆盖远程访问），或改为仅绑定 127.0.0.1 并使用隧道。

devices.empty.en: No paired devices yet. Scan the QR or open the link to add one.
devices.empty.zh: 还没有已配对的设备。扫码或打开链接后会出现在这里。

stopped.hint.en: Remote access is stopped. Click "Refresh QR" to re-enable it.
stopped.hint.zh: 已停止远程访问。点击"刷新二维码"重新开启。

tunnel.starting.en: The public tunnel is starting; the QR code will switch to a public link shortly…
tunnel.starting.zh: 公网隧道启动中，二维码将自动变为公网链接…

tunnel.failed.en: The public tunnel failed to start: {error}

relay.registering.en: Syncing the ephemeral tunnel to the stable hostname (<id>.dsh-market.com)…
relay.registering.zh: 正在把临时隧道同步到固定域名（<id>.dsh-market.com）…

relay.failed.en: Stable-hostname sync failed: {error}. Retrying automatically; the QR may use the ephemeral address meanwhile.
relay.failed.zh: 固定域名同步失败：{error}。正在自动重试，期间二维码可能使用临时地址。

settings.description.en: Phone pairing, public tunnel and device limits.
settings.description.zh: 手机配对、公网隧道与设备限额。

settings.enabledHint.en: When off, the sidebar entry is removed and pairing routes plus the LAN fence stop.
settings.enabledHint.zh: 关闭后移除侧边栏入口并停用配对路由与局域网栅栏。

settings.tokenTtlMsHint.en: How long a minted QR link stays valid before it dies.
settings.tokenTtlMsHint.zh: 新生成的二维码链接在此时间后失效。

settings.offlineAfterMsHint.en: A paired device flips to offline when it has not been seen for this long.
settings.offlineAfterMsHint.zh: 配对设备超过该时长未上报心跳即视为离线。

settings.maxDevicesHint.en: Hard cap on paired device sessions; the oldest is evicted when full.
settings.maxDevicesHint.zh: 超过上限时淘汰最旧的设备会话。

settings.idleExpireMsHint.en: A paired device with no heartbeat or request for this long is deleted and must scan again. Default is 7 days.
settings.idleExpireMsHint.zh: 超过该时长没有任何心跳或请求的已配对设备会被删除，必须重新扫码。默认 7 天。

settings.cookieNameHint.en: Cookie that carries the paired device id.
settings.cookieNameHint.zh: 携带已配对设备标识的 Cookie 名称。

settings.requirePairingForLanHint.en: On: a desktop Web GUI at a non-loopback origin rides the gated /remote channel and must carry a live paired-device cookie. Off: the desktop stays on its original paths (only useful when that origin is already trusted) and pairing only manages tokens/status.
settings.requirePairingForLanHint.zh: 开启：非本机回环的桌面 Web GUI 改走门控的 /remote，必须携带有效配对 Cookie；关闭：桌面继续走普通路径（仅在该来源已被 SDK 信任时有意义），配对只管理令牌与状态。

settings.publicBaseUrlHint.en: The public URL of a tunnel in front of this server, e.g. a Cloudflare Tunnel: https://xxx.trycloudflare.com; a fixed-hostname tunnel (token below) also goes here. When set, the QR link is built from it so a phone anywhere can pair; leave blank for LAN-only usage.
settings.publicBaseUrlHint.zh: 内网穿透的公网地址，如 Cloudflare Tunnel：https://xxx.trycloudflare.com；固定域名隧道（下方令牌）也填这里。填写后二维码将生成公网链接，手机不在同一网络也能配对；留空则仅局域网可用。

settings.autoTunnelHint.en: When on, the plugin runs its own Cloudflare quick tunnel (no tool installation needed) and keeps the public address and trust config in sync automatically, so a phone anywhere can pair at any time; note the ephemeral hostname changes on every restart, so phones must scan again. The named-tunnel token below and the manual public address above are ignored while this is on.
settings.autoTunnelHint.zh: 开启后插件自动启动 Cloudflare quick tunnel（无需安装任何工具），并自动更新公网地址与信任配置，手机随时可用公网配对；注意临时域名每次重启都会变化，手机需重新扫码。开启时忽略下方固定隧道令牌与上方手动公网地址。

settings.tunnelToken.zh: 固定域名隧道令牌（Cloudflare Tunnel）

settings.tunnelTokenHint.en: Paste a Cloudflare named-tunnel token (the value of cloudflared tunnel run --token) and the plugin runs the tunnel itself: the public hostname stays fixed, so a phone pairs once and never again across restarts. First map the public hostname to http://127.0.0.1:<port> in the Cloudflare dashboard and enter the same hostname as the public address above. Lower precedence than the auto quick tunnel.
settings.tunnelTokenHint.zh: 填入 Cloudflare 命名隧道的 Token（即 cloudflared tunnel run --token 的值），插件会自动运行该隧道：公共主机名固定不变，手机配对一次后重启也无需重新配对。需先在 Cloudflare 控制台把公共主机名映射到 http://127.0.0.1:<端口>，并在上方"公网地址"填写同一域名。优先级低于"自动公网隧道"。

settings.relay.zh: 固定域名中继（推荐开启）

settings.relayHint.en: When on, the auto tunnel additionally registers a never-changing public subdomain (<id>.dsh-market.com, relayed by the dsh-market edge to your ephemeral tunnel), so a phone pairs once and the QR and bookmark stay valid across restarts. Traffic transits the dsh-market edge (the same trust point as the ephemeral tunnel); turn off to fall back to the raw ephemeral address, which needs re-pairing after every restart. Applies to the auto public tunnel only.
settings.relayHint.zh: 开启后自动隧道会额外注册一个固定不变的公网子域名（<id>.dsh-market.com，由 dsh-market 边缘中继到你的临时隧道），手机配对一次后重启无需重新扫码，二维码与书签地址永远不变。流量经由 dsh-market 边缘转发（与临时隧道相同的信任面）；关闭则回退为纯临时地址，每次重启需重新配对。仅对"自动公网隧道"生效。

settings.lanBindHint.en: When on, the plugin writes a managed block into the profile patch defaulting the bind to 0.0.0.0 (an explicit --host flag still wins), and maintains the matching host firewall rule (Windows/Linux; other platforms need none). When off, the block pins 127.0.0.1. The bind change usually takes effect after dsh web restarts.
settings.lanBindHint.zh: 开启后插件把绑定默认改写为 0.0.0.0 并写入 profile 补丁（显式 --host 仍优先），同时维护主机防火墙放行（Windows/Linux；macOS 无需管理）；关闭回退 127.0.0.1。绑定变化通常在重启 dsh web 后生效。

lan.firewall.bad.zh: 防火墙未放行（需管理员权限）

lan.firewall.unmanaged.en: firewall not managed (no supported firewall detected)
lan.firewall.unmanaged.zh: 防火墙不由插件管理（未检测到受支持的防火墙）

lan.untouched.en: The toggle has never been used; the profile patch is only written once you flip it.
lan.untouched.zh: 开关尚未使用：打开后插件才会改写 profile 补丁。

lan.pendingRestart.en: The bind change takes effect after dsh web restarts.
lan.pendingRestart.zh: 绑定将在重启 dsh web 后生效。

settings.notExposed.en: This DSH version does not expose this plugin's settings namespace to the configuration page, so the form is unavailable. Edit $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml directly, or confirm that the plugin owning the namespace is mounted with its settings domain and restart.
settings.notExposed.zh: 当前 DSH 版本未向设置页暴露本插件的配置命名空间，表单不可用。可编辑 $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml 直接配置，或确认提供该命名空间的插件已挂载其设置域并重启。

settings.saveFailed.en: The deployment did not accept these values; they were left for you to correct.
settings.saveFailed.zh: 部署未接受这些值，已保留供你修改。

settings.invalidNumber.en: Enter a number, or leave blank to use the default.
settings.invalidNumber.zh: 请输入数字，留空则使用默认值。
